subject: Renewal governance: vendor refresh, capacity uplift & procurement handoff
messages:
From: Amit Shah <amit.shah@crestline.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procure@crestline.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal / onboarding refresh + seat uplift

Hi Marissa,

We're getting ready for our annual renewal with Redwood and want to do two things: refresh the vendor onboarding materials for our internal procurement team, and increase committed capacity by ~20% for Q1. Procurement asked me to reach out to confirm the exact steps on your side (pricing amendment vs amendment + PO, required evidence, and timeline).

Key facts: current term ends 2027-01-31, current committed tokens 1.2B/mo — target 1.44B/mo starting 2027-02-01. We may need a short-term prorated charge for February.

Can you send a short checklist and confirm who on your ops/legal side I should loop in for the amendment? Procurement (cc'd) wants to have the contract and PO lined up by Dec 9.

Thanks,
Amit
Amit Shah
Head of AI Platforms
Crestline Health

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Amit Shah <amit.shah@crestline.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal / onboarding refresh + seat uplift

Hi Amit — great to hear from you and thanks for the clear numbers. I attached a short "Renewal & Procurement Checklist" that walks through typical touchpoints (amendment vs SOW, PO timing, evidence bundle, and billing/proration).

Quick answers up front:
- We can handle the uplift as a one-line amendment to the existing MSA (no new SOW required for the capacity bump).
- Procurement will need the signed amendment + a PO referencing RDW-4389.
- For proration: we'll provide a pro forma invoice for the partial month that Procurement can include in the PO.

Next steps I propose:
1) Rafael (copied) will share the draft amendment and mark the term change.
2) Jordan will follow up with the capacity quote and formal XLS for Procurement.
3) Amit / Procurement confirm timeline for PO submission (target Dec 9).

I'll host a 30-min sync for all parties Tuesday if that helps — I can send a calendar invite once you confirm.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Attachment: renewal-checklist-crestline.pdf

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Amit Shah <amit.shah@crestline.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Nov 2026 11:42:00 -0800
Subject: Draft amendment + contract notes (RDW-4389)

Amit / Marissa — attaching an amendment draft that switches the committed capacity and updates the term effective 2027-02-01. Quick notes:
- Amendment keeps existing MSA terms; we only change committed tokens and billing cadence.
- If Crestline prefers a renewed 12-month term starting 2027-02-01, we can add language for auto-renew; Rafael to confirm inlined SLA language if Procurement requests it.
- Procurement typically needs: signed amendment, PO referencing RDW-4389, and a copy of the invoice/pro-forma showing proration.

I'll flag any clauses that Procurement historically redlines (data residency note; audit window length). If team wants, I can open a redline loop with Crestline legal.

Attachment: amendment-draft-RDW-4389-20261130.docx

Regards,
Rafael Mendes
Sales Operations Counsel | Redwood Inference
rafael_mendes@redwood.ai

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Amit Shah <amit.shah@crestline.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procure@crestline.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Nov 2026 14:08:00 -0800
Subject: Capacity quote and PO guidance (RDW-4389)

Hey Amit — attaching the formal capacity quote and a simple PO template we've used with other healthcare customers. Line items include: base commitment (current), uplift delta (20%), and a prorated charge for Feb 2027. If Procurement prefers net-30 or net-45, let us know and we'll surface the billing SLA.

Highlights:
- Capacity price per token unchanged; uplift charge = 20% * current monthly commitment.
- Proration calculated from 2027-02-01 start date; we included the pro-forma invoice number in the sheet.
- Please set PO to reference RDW-4389 and attach the signed amendment when you submit.

Attachment: capacity-quote-crestline-RDW-4389.xlsx

If Dec 9 is still the deadline, can Procurement confirm by EOD Dec 3 so we have time for countersignature?

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Amit Shah <amit.shah@crestline.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Olivia Park <olivia.park@crestline.com>, Procurement Team <procure@crestline.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Dec 2026 09:16:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal governance: vendor refresh, capacity uplift & procurement handoff

Thanks team — this is helpful. Procurement confirms they can target Dec 9 PROVIDED we have the final amendment by Dec 3 to route internally. Olivia (procurement lead) is looped.

Couple of asks from our side: can Redwood provide a short one-page vendor onboarding summary (evidence items + SOC2 link + contact for security attestation) so our procurement ops can close the file quickly? Also confirm whether the amendment needs a countersignature from Crestline legal or whether the PO + signed amendment is sufficient.

I'll aim to get Procurement's PO draft to you by Dec 6.

Best,
Amit

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Amit Shah <amit.shah@crestline.com>, Olivia Park <olivia.park@crestline.com>, Procurement Team <procure@crestline.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 02 Dec 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal governance: vendor refresh, capacity uplift & procurement handoff

Perfect — we'll get you everything by end of day Dec 3: final amendment (Rafael will drop redline comments today), one-page vendor evidence summary, SOC 2 link, and the DocuSign powerform to sign. Once Procure sends the PO (target Dec 6), Jordan will validate the PO fields and Rafael will countersign the amendment.

I created a short timeline below:
- Dec 2 (EOD): Rafael finalizes amendment; security one-pager and SOC2 link delivered.
- Dec 3: Crestline reviews and confirms (internal routing).
- Dec 6: Crestline submits PO.
- Dec 9: Target for completed paperwork and invoices so uplift can go live Feb 1.

I'll also open a calendar invite for a 30-min sync on Dec 3 (15:00 PST) — please accept if that works.

Thanks everyone — looking forward to continuing to scale with Crestline.

Best regards,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
